page_title: NAP 4-1 UDI | Napoli v Udinese 27/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+3' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' Napoli take a short corner kick.

89' The ball goes out of play and Napoli have been awarded a corner kick. Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) blows a big chance to score after blasting the ball under the crossbar, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
87' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Udinese.

87' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball goes behind for a corner. Udinese will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
83' Rudi Garcia has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) replacing Frank Anguissa.
83' The substitution has been made. Eljif Elmas (Napoli) has replaced Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.

81' 4 - 1 Goal! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia hands Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the left side of the goal. 4:1.

81' 3 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 3:1. Alex Meret was helpless.
78' Napoli hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

74' 3 - 0 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 3:0.
74' Gianluca Manganiello has issued a yellow card to Giovanni Simeone (Napoli).
73' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jordan Zemura (Udinese) is coming onto the pitch as Hassane Kamara cannot continue after picking up an injury.
72' Andrea Sottil decides to make a substitution. Sandi Lovric will be replaced by Roberto Pereyra (Udinese).
71' Piotr Zielinski goes off the pitch and Jens Cajuste (Napoli) comes on.
70' Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
70' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Joao Ferreira (Udinese) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
68' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the right post!
68' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Napoli comes to nothing.

66' Marco Silvestri pulls off a great save to deny Giovanni Simeone (Napoli), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Napoli.

66' A rebound sits up perfectly for Hassane Kamara (Udinese), who connects nicely with the ball from mid-range but sends it miles wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.

65' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
63' Rudi Garcia has decided to substitute Matteo Politano and he is replaced by Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli).
63' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Victor Osimhen as he is replaced by Giovanni Simeone (Napoli).
62' Yellow card. Nehuen Perez (Udinese) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
62' A spell of possession for Napoli in an attempt to control the game.
59' A corner kick by Udinese is thwarted by the well prepared Alex Meret (Napoli).
58' Andrea Sottil has decided to make a change. Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) replaces Walace.
58' It will be a substitution. Isaac Success (Udinese) is ready to enter the pitch as Florian Thauvin walks off.
58' Today's match ends for Festy Ebosele who will be replaced by Joao Ferreira (Udinese).
56' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and fires at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort only hits the left-hand post!
54' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Napoli will take a throw-in.

53' CHANCE! Stanislav Lobotka finds Victor Osimhen (Napoli) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
52' Martin Payero (Udinese) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
52' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Udinese can continue in their attacking effort.
51' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Gianluca Manganiello who sees an offensive foul.
50' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) works the corner short.
50' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The ball is out of play. Napoli win a corner kick.
50' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) makes a rough challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) is able to continue to play.
49' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
48' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) picks up an injury.
48' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
47' The corner is swung in but Udinese can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.

45+1' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
45+1' Mario Rui (Napoli) tackles a bit over-zealously and Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

43' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Florian Thauvin (Udinese), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles away of the left post. Poor effort. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.

41' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Alex Meret!
39' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Matteo Politano laid the ball off to Victor Osimhen (Napoli), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
38' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

37' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Victor Osimhen (Napoli), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles over the bar. Poor effort. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
36' Matteo Politano (Napoli) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
36' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Now Napoli have a corner.
35' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli).

32' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Gianluca Manganiello blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
29' Napoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
27' Napoli work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

27' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
24' A snap shot by Mario Rui (Napoli) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Marco Silvestri produces a good save to thwart him.
19' 1 - 0 Goal! Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Marco Silvestri to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
18' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) is going to take the penalty!
18' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Napoli!
17' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Napoli, he's going to review using VAR.
16' Gianluca Manganiello blows the whistle, Festy Ebosele (Udinese) is penalised for a foul. Napoli have been awarded a penalty kick!
14' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.

13' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Napoli.

11' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
10' Napoli keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
8' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
5' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) attempts to find Victor Osimhen, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
3' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Napoli will take the kick-off.
Gianluca Manganiello will officiate today.
